keywords_en: keyed nonces and recent roots to be proposed for Hegotá at ACDE
summary_en: soispoke said he will propose keyed nonces (EIP-8250) and recent roots (EIP-8272) for Hegotá at Thursday's ACDE, calling these primitives on top of frame transactions essential for making privacy dapp transactions censorship resistant and trustless. StarkWare published a roadmap toward an end-to-end post-quantum secure Starknet before Q-day. ethbeat explained how L2BEAT's privacy dashboard tracks anonymity sets. The checked arithmetic opcodes EIP was merged. An onchain proposal to renew the ENS security council was voted down, sparking a dispute.
